answer: In an agent marketplace buying marble for a harbor terrace, each identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days to receive a fixed daily bidding quota. Collateral cannot back two identities at once, so an attacker seeking a thousand quotas must immobilize $100,000 rather than merely generate usernames. This does not establish unique owners; it makes extra sybil influence cost capital and a month of foregone use of that money.
